name: Cloverdale Food
old_description: Cloverdale makes it easy to snack on-the-go with our shelf stable Beef Tangy Snackers® summer sausage sticks. Gluten-free, beef summer sausage sticks pack 5 grams of protein per serving. With outstanding taste and texture, this artisan, single serve stick of summer sausage is expertly seasoned for grab and go protein, and proudly made in the USA.
about:
Cloverdale Foods traces its roots to 1915, when founder Hoy Russell opened Mandan Creamery in Mandan, North Dakota. The small dairy operation quickly built a reputation for fresh, high-quality products among local kitchens. A few years later the company expanded into premium pork items, laying the groundwork for the brand known today. The business remains headquartered in Mandan.

Today Cloverdale produces shelf-stable beef summer sausage sticks marketed as Beef Tangy Snackers®. Each gluten-free stick delivers five grams of protein and is seasoned for grab-and-go convenience. The product line reflects a focus on artisan, single-serve meat snacks made in the United States. No details on facility size or annual output are publicly disclosed.

The company serves retail and foodservice channels, supplying consumers seeking portable protein options. Its early customer base included area households and loyal buyers of its dairy and pork lines; the current snack sticks target on-the-go snacking occasions. Distribution extends through grocery and convenience store networks.

Russell’s original insistence on uncompromising quality remains the stated guiding principle. The company promises to delight families with high-quality, flavorful meat products that create lasting memories. This commitment to taste and texture is cited as the core differentiator.
